answer_2.quote: We employ both subjective metrics: Mean Opinion Score (MOS), Comparison Mean Opinion Score (CMOS), and an objective metric: Mean Cepstral Distortion (MCD) to evaluate the audio quality... we also use F0 Root Mean Square Error (F0 RMSE) and Pitch Alignment Accuracy (PAA) to estimate the pitch correction performance.

answer_4.quote: During testing, each audio sample is listened to by at least 10 qualified testers, all majoring in vocal music. ... For MOS, each tester is asked to evaluate the subjective naturalness of a sentence on a 1-5 Likert scale. For CMOS, listeners are asked to compare pairs of audio ... we tell listeners to focus on one aspect and ignore the other aspect when scoring MOS/CMOS of each aspect.
answer_4.guideline: Listeners evaluate audio quality (naturalness, pronunciation, sound quality) and vocal tone quality using MOS and CMOS scales, focusing on one aspect at a time.
